evidences.evidence_quote: For instance, Wei et al. [14] inspects subtle disturbances on a target loudspeaker and recovers the audio signal by analyzing the received signal strength (RSS) readings of WiFi packets. Moreover, researchers also use RFID tags [15] and mmWave radar [16] to detect reﬂected vibration signals for eavesdropping.
evidences.evidence_context: Wireless-based. Wireless-based approaches spy on voice information by analyzing wireless signals reflected from vibrating objects. For instance, Wei et al. [14] inspects subtle disturbances on a target loudspeaker and recovers the audio signal by analyzing the received signal strength (RSS) readings of WiFi packets. Moreover, researchers also use RFID tags [15] and mmWave radar [16] to detect reflected vibration signals for eavesdropping.
